item.title: First day of winter feels more like spring
item.description: As of this writing, December 21st is the official start of winter. Today is also the shortest day. This past week has been uneventful weather wise. The temperatures are be very mild but cool at night. Lows will be in the 50s and highs will reach upper 70s.
